module: Node "Generic Set/Get Variable" (repeat_instant). Reads or writes a flowgraph variable by name (varName, + optional numeric suffix concatenated). Source: project variables (mgr.variables) or those of the current graph. In getter mode: output pin val (any); in setter mode: input pin val. The flow is copied to the output.
notes: In getter mode, the output is only written if the value read is "truthy": a variable equal to false or nil does not update the output.
The field C.value = nil is not used.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: getter = true, global = true and getter pins.

work.desc: Chooses the variables table, builds the name, then reads (target:get) or writes (target:change) the variable.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the node's state in the given table.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores getter/global and recreates the pins.

setupGetPins.desc: Switches to "Generic Getter" mode: output pin val.

setupSetPins.desc: Switches to "Generic Setter" mode: input pin val.

drawCustomProperties.desc: "Use Project as Source" and "Is Getter" checkboxes.
